+@pytest.mark.parametrize("explicit_cause", [False, True])
+def test_preserves_application_exception_chain(
+    test_client_factory: TestClientFactory,
+    explicit_cause: bool,
+) -> None:
+    root_error = LookupError("application context")
+
+    async def error_endpoint(_: Request) -> None:
+        try:
+            raise root_error
+        except LookupError as exc:
+            if explicit_cause:
+                raise RuntimeError("application error") from exc
+            raise RuntimeError("application error")
+
+    async def passthrough(request: Request, call_next: RequestResponseEndpoint) -> Response:
+        return await call_next(request)
+
+    app = Starlette(
+        middleware=[Middleware(BaseHTTPMiddleware, dispatch=passthrough)],
+        routes=[Route("/", error_endpoint)],
+    )
+
+    client = test_client_factory(app)
+    with pytest.raises(RuntimeError, match="application error") as exc_info:
+        client.get("/")
+
+    assert (exc_info.value.__cause__ or exc_info.value.__context__) is root_error
+
